items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: But they didn't know us from Adam, all they knew was this Negro Revue.

ctx.x: I mean, what I'm saying, they weren't familiar with the records, or were they at that time?

Records weren't an item in those days. It was in-person things, you see.. Records were just something incidental that people had. They had records, but they didn't relate from records as to your popularity. They'd go to see you in person. And we had recorded while we were in Berlin, we had made four numbers and I guess -- the distribution wasn't as great as it is now, they were just local things, maybe one country over and one country around, something like that. But they didn't know us from Adam, all they knew…
How large a show was this, along with the band?
